thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — p99 latency +~15% on llama3-13b hosted yesterday. I traced it to the KV path; suspect the slice heuristic.
perf-bot: perf-regression-detector: alert 4419876500 — p99 up 14.8% vs baseline. CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/4421
maria: I pulled a flamegraph from node-4, big memcpy hotspot between attention kernel invocations.
alex: here are the top lines from the profile I captured:
```
memcpy               32.1%  (copy of KV into aligned buffer)
attention_kernel     28.0%
kernel_launch_overhead 12.3%
selector_decision    6.5%  (fell back to generic kernel)
```
sam: timeline: we merged the slice heuristic that fragments KV into 4 segments for short sequences to improve occupancy. That optimization assumes alignment-friendly head_dim. On some head_dim values (96) we do an extra copy to aligned buffer.
tj: so selector chose the smaller-slice path which incurs multiple memcpys vs one big fused-kernel path.
maria: exactly. head_dim % 32 != 0 -> unaligned loads. runtime copies into temporary aligned buffer before calling the SIMD kernel. For 13b with head_dim=96 we hit that.
alex: reproduction (super small):
```
# reproduce locally
python tools/run_perf.py --model=llama3-13b --batch=1 --seq=16 --warmup=5 --iters=50 --profile=true
# observe memcpy spikes at step ~12
```
tj: quick mitigation options:
- prefer fused-kernel (avoid slice) when head_dim % 32 != 0
- increase slice_threshold so we only slice for extremely high seq/throughput cases
- add an alignment-aware fastpath that avoids memcpy for odd head_dim
sam: I sketched a selector change in a branch. Logic: if head_dim % 32 != 0 or kv_stride_misaligned -> prefer fused_kv_path. Microbench shows p99 drop back to baseline.
alex: can you post numbers?
sam: microbench after change (13b, seq16, batch1): p50 12ms same, p99 78ms -> baseline 79ms, previous (slice) 92ms. So ~15% improvement vs bad path.
maria: also noticed rope_theta default bumped in recent model metadata (3.2) which changed internal kv stride layout in a couple of model builds; worth verifying model metadata pipeline so selector sees the correct stride.
tj: action items:
- sam: open PR for selector change + unit test (alignment case) — include microbench results. (assign to sam)
- maria: add a CI perf test that runs the small-seq, odd-head-dim case and fails on >10% p99 regression. (assign to maria)
- alex: coordinate a quick canary roll on dedicated nodes tonight if PR is low risk.
perf-bot: scheduled perf-run: https://ci.internal/runs/4429 (will run after PR merge)
alex: thanks — if anyone sees other head_dim values (e.g., 128 vs 96) that behave oddly, drop them here. :thumbsup:
